title: How Many Years Do You Have Left?
seoTitle: How Many Years Do You Have Left? | Lifestyle Personality Quiz
seoDescription: Take a playful lifestyle personality quiz about habits, energy, stress, curiosity, food, movement, and everyday choices to reveal your years-left vibe.
pageTitle: How Many Years Do You Have Left?
summary: A cheeky personality quiz that turns your habits, energy, stress style, and daily choices into a playful years-left vibe.

homepage.title: How Many Years Do You Have Left?
homepage.summary: Answer quick lifestyle questions about habits, energy, stress, food, fun, and routine to reveal your playful years-left vibe.
homepage.thumbnailAlt: Warm lifestyle collage with candles, fruit, shoes, coffee, and an hourglass for a years-left personality quiz

landing.quickStartText: Answer these questions to find out how long you have left.

footer.topicText: This quiz uses everyday lifestyle clues like routine, food, movement, stress, sleep, social energy, curiosity, and tiny brain teasers to create a playful personality-style result.
footer.aboutText: This quiz is for entertainment and self-reflection only. It does not predict your lifespan, health, future, mortality risk, or medical outcomes. Results are playful lifestyle-style profiles based only on your quiz choices. If you have health concerns, speak to a qualified healthcare professional.

profiles.title: Your years-left vibe is Centenarian Energy.
profiles.copy: Your playful range feels like: 90s and beyond. Your answers give off steady-habit energy: small joys, a bit of movement, and a surprising talent for choosing the sensible option without making life boring.

profiles.title: Your years-left vibe is The Steady Long Game.
profiles.copy: Your playful range feels like: late-80s-to-90s energy. Your answers point to a slow-burn lifestyle: practical choices, decent pacing, and the kind of everyday consistency that makes your future self quietly grateful.

profiles.title: Your years-left vibe is The Balanced Realist.
profiles.copy: Your playful range feels like: strong-80s energy. Your answers suggest a grounded mix of sense and fun. You know life is not a wellness brochure, but you also know when a small choice keeps things smoother.

profiles.title: Your years-left vibe is Weekend Chaos Mode.
profiles.copy: Your playful range feels like: wild-card 80s energy. Your answers have bright, chaotic, “this became a story” energy. You may not always choose the tidy path, but you bring spark, humor, and momentum.

profiles.title: Your years-left vibe is The Stress Sprinter.
profiles.copy: Your playful range feels like: high-speed 70s-to-80s energy. Your answers point to deadline-fuelled energy: fast, capable, and occasionally powered by pure suspense. Your best upgrade is pacing, not panic.

profiles.title: Your years-left vibe is The Comfort Creature.
profiles.copy: Your playful range feels like: cozy 80s energy. Your answers lean familiar, low-drama, and comfort-loving. You know the value of ease, and your sweet spot is soft living with just enough fresh air.

profiles.title: Your years-left vibe is Adventure Fuse.
profiles.copy: Your playful range feels like: unpredictable 80s energy. Your answers have restless, curious, say-yes energy. You are drawn to novelty, stories, movement, and the feeling that a normal day could still become memorable.

profiles.title: Your years-left vibe is Reset Needed.
profiles.copy: Your playful range feels like: comeback-era energy. Your answers suggest your system is asking for a reset: fewer tiny fires, more breathing room, and a rhythm that lets you feel like a person again. Very fixable. Very relatable.

stageGroups.title: Daily Rhythm
stageGroups.encouragement: Your rhythm says a lot already. Now let us see what fuels it.

questions.prompt: Your ideal Saturday morning starts with...
choices: A slow breakfast and a plan that actually feels possible
Five alarms, three errands, and a heroic amount of coffee
No plan at all, just seeing where the day pulls you
questions.explanation: Your first move of the day hints at the pace you naturally trust.

questions.prompt: When your week gets crowded, what usually saves you?
choices: A simple list and one thing at a time
Pushing harder until the pressure finally breaks
Cancelling everything and choosing the sofa in peace
questions.explanation: Busy weeks reveal whether you reset, sprint, or retreat.

questions.prompt: Pick the daily routine that sounds least annoying.
choices: A short walk, a decent meal, and an earlyish night
A burst of work, a burst of fun, and no boring schedule
Whatever feels good in the moment
questions.explanation: The routine you can tolerate often says more than the routine you admire.

questions.prompt: Your phone battery is at 3%. What happens next?
choices: You calmly switch to low power and save it for what matters
You keep scrolling and trust destiny
You panic, borrow a charger, and check every outlet
questions.explanation: Tiny emergencies are a surprisingly good window into your default style.

questions.prompt: Which evening sounds most like your reset button?
choices: Cooking something simple and closing the laptop
A spontaneous plan that turns into a story
Blanket, snacks, and absolutely no further questions
questions.explanation: Your reset style points toward the kind of energy you protect.

questions.prompt: How often do you make life harder than it needs to be?
choices: Only when I ignore the obvious fix
Regularly, but at least it keeps things interesting
I am currently doing that right now
questions.explanation: Self-awareness is half the battle, and occasionally the whole comedy.

stageGroups.title: Food And Fuel
stageGroups.encouragement: Fuel choices are on the table. Next up: how your body likes to move.

questions.prompt: Which snack table are you drifting toward?
choices: Fruit, nuts, and something that still feels like a treat
Cake first, logic later
Whatever is closest to my hand
questions.explanation: Snack instincts can reveal whether you chase balance, joy, or convenience.

questions.prompt: Your breakfast personality is...
choices: Reliable enough to stop the morning wobble
A coffee with far too much confidence
Breakfast? I prefer a dramatic lunch debut
questions.explanation: Morning fuel often shows whether you plan ahead or improvise boldly.

questions.prompt: At a restaurant, you usually pick...
choices: The thing you know will leave you feeling good
The richest thing on the menu because life is short
Something new because curiosity is louder than caution
questions.explanation: Your menu choice shows how you balance comfort, curiosity, and after-effects.

questions.prompt: Your water bottle is most likely...
choices: Nearby and actually used
Somewhere in the house, technically
Replaced by coffee until further notice
questions.explanation: Small habits are not dramatic, but they do reveal your daily operating system.

questions.prompt: Someone offers you a mystery smoothie. You...
choices: Ask what is in it, then decide
Drink it because mystery is part of the brand
Politely hold it and hope no one notices
questions.explanation: Your smoothie strategy says a lot about curiosity versus control.

questions.prompt: Which food motto sounds most like you?
choices: Mostly sensible, sometimes celebratory
If it brings joy, it has a seat at the table
Future me can file the complaint
questions.explanation: Food mottos reveal the tiny negotiations you make with yourself.

stageGroups.title: Movement And Energy
stageGroups.encouragement: Movement tells one story. Stress and sleep tell another.

questions.prompt: Which movement plan would you actually keep?
choices: A walk that does not require a new personality
A dramatic two-week fitness era
Dancing around while cleaning and calling it cardio
questions.explanation: The best plan is usually the one your real life will tolerate.

questions.prompt: When stairs and an elevator are both available, you choose...
choices: Stairs if I am not carrying the entire universe
Elevator, because civilization invented it for a reason
Whichever one gets me there with flair
questions.explanation: Tiny movement choices often reveal your everyday energy setting.

questions.prompt: Your energy at 3 p.m. is usually...
choices: Still usable, if treated kindly
Powered by deadlines and mild panic
Looking for a soft place to land
questions.explanation: Afternoon energy has a way of exposing the truth.

questions.prompt: Pick the activity that sounds most fun.
choices: A scenic walk with good conversation
A last-minute road trip with snacks
A long bath and zero notifications
questions.explanation: Fun is a strong clue to the kind of life pace you recharge from.

questions.prompt: If a friend says, “Let’s try something active,” you think...
choices: Sure, as long as it is not secretly a punishment
Excellent, make it weird
I cheer from a chair
questions.explanation: Your reaction to movement shows how much novelty you enjoy.

questions.prompt: Which phrase describes your body language on a busy day?
choices: Moving steadily, conserving energy
Fast, tense, and somehow everywhere
Collapsed elegantly at the earliest opportunity
questions.explanation: Busy-day body language shows whether you pace yourself or burn bright.

stageGroups.title: Stress And Sleep
stageGroups.encouragement: You have survived the pressure round. Time for a few brainy little detours.

questions.prompt: Your bedtime routine is closest to...
choices: A decent wind-down that mostly works
One more thing, then one more thing, then oops
Falling asleep wherever the day drops me
questions.explanation: Bedtime habits are basically a diary written in yawns.

questions.prompt: When stress walks into the room, you usually...
choices: Shrink the problem into the next clear step
Start solving six things at once
Avoid eye contact and hope it leaves
questions.explanation: Stress style often reveals your strongest and funniest coping pattern.

questions.prompt: Your alarm clock relationship is...
choices: Respectful but not romantic
A daily courtroom battle
Mostly imaginary because I wake before it
questions.explanation: Morning timing says plenty about your rhythm.

questions.prompt: A tiny inconvenience appears. You...
choices: Handle it before it becomes a saga
Make it a saga with excellent narration
Leave it for later and hope it works out
questions.explanation: Small inconveniences reveal whether you tidy, dramatize, or delay.

questions.prompt: What helps you sleep best?
choices: A calm room and a calmer brain
Being completely exhausted by adventure
Background noise and a soft escape from reality
questions.explanation: Your sleep setup shows what your nervous system seems to ask for.

questions.prompt: Which stress snack are you emotionally choosing?
choices: Tea, toast, or something gentle
Crunchy chaos with confidence
Whatever can be eaten while standing
questions.explanation: Stress snacks are not science, but they are very honest.

stageGroups.title: Thinking Style
stageGroups.encouragement: Nice. Your thinking style is showing. Now let us check your social battery.

questions.prompt: A quick calendar puzzle appears. You...
choices: Count it carefully before answering
Guess fast and trust the vibe
Wonder why the calendar is testing you
questions.explanation: This is not about a perfect score. It shows whether you slow down, go by instinct, or want the puzzle to leave politely.

questions.prompt: Someone asks you to remember three random words. You...
choices: Repeat them in order until they stick
Turn them into a strange little story
Hope at least one word survives
questions.explanation: Memory style can reveal whether you like structure, imagination, or a gentler level of pressure.

questions.prompt: A number pattern shows up. You...
choices: Look for the clean rule
Pick the answer with confidence
Hope the pattern is friendly
questions.explanation: Pattern questions can reveal how calmly you handle small moments of uncertainty.

questions.prompt: A direction puzzle asks you to turn twice. You...
choices: Walk through it step by step in your head
Picture the route like a tiny adventure
Answer quickly and check later
questions.explanation: Direction puzzles are a neat clue to whether you process slowly, visually, or at speed.

questions.prompt: Which tiny puzzle would you actually enjoy?
choices: A neat pattern with a satisfying answer
A strange riddle that gets people talking
A puzzle someone else explains kindly
questions.explanation: The puzzle you choose says something about curiosity, patience, and pressure.

questions.prompt: A friend says, “I have a theory.” You...
choices: Listen, then ask the useful question
Add a dramatic theory of your own
Listen while hoping it has a simple ending
questions.explanation: Your thinking style shows up in how you handle other people’s ideas.

stageGroups.title: Social Battery
stageGroups.encouragement: Your social battery has spoken. Next we look at routine, risk, and tiny chaos.

questions.prompt: Your perfect group plan has...
choices: Good people, clear timing, and an easy exit
A twist no one saw coming
A quiet place nearby just in case
questions.explanation: Social plans reveal how much structure your energy wants.

questions.prompt: At a party, you are most likely...
choices: Talking deeply with one or two people
Becoming part of a story that starts with “somehow”
Helping with snacks because it gives you purpose
questions.explanation: Party behavior is just personality wearing better lighting.

questions.prompt: When someone texts “quick question,” you feel...
choices: Ready, but cautious
Immediately suspicious of the word quick
Happy if it turns into gossip
questions.explanation: Your reaction to vague messages shows your pressure radar.

questions.prompt: Your friends would probably call you...
choices: Reliable in a refreshingly normal way
A lovable source of side quests
Hard to pin down, but worth the wait
questions.explanation: Friend descriptions reveal the energy you bring into a room.

questions.prompt: After a big social day, you need...
choices: A quiet evening and a clean slate
Another plan if the vibe is good
A long quiet reset before I feel normal again
questions.explanation: Recharge time is one of the clearest lifestyle clues.

questions.prompt: Your ideal conversation is...
choices: Warm, funny, and not trying too hard
Deep enough to forget the time
Short enough to leave me peaceful
questions.explanation: Conversation style shows the kind of connection that keeps you lit up.

stageGroups.title: Risk And Routine
stageGroups.encouragement: Tiny chaos logged. Now we check what keeps life interesting.

questions.prompt: A cheap flight appears for tomorrow. You...
choices: Check the details before your imagination takes over
Start packing emotionally
Close the tab because tomorrow is already too soon
questions.explanation: Travel impulses reveal how much uncertainty you enjoy.

questions.prompt: Which risk feels most like you?
choices: Trying a new habit without making it dramatic
Saying yes before reading the full plan
Ordering something new and hoping for the best
questions.explanation: Everyday risk does not need danger; sometimes it is just novelty.

questions.prompt: Your calendar is usually...
choices: Useful enough to prevent disasters
Decorative, in theory
Full of things I forgot I agreed to
questions.explanation: Calendar style is life-admin honesty in grid form.

questions.prompt: When a plan changes last minute, you...
choices: Adjust and find the new sensible route
Pretend this was the plan all along
Need a minute to reboot
questions.explanation: Plan changes reveal flexibility, flair, or reset needs.

questions.prompt: What is your relationship with safety instructions?
choices: I skim the important bits
I learn them after things get complicated
I read them and then read them again
questions.explanation: This is about attention style, not bravery points.

questions.prompt: Which routine would improve your life most?
choices: A simple weekly reset
More play built into normal days
A pause button for my brain
questions.explanation: The routine you crave points toward the profile your answers are building.

stageGroups.title: Joy And Curiosity
stageGroups.encouragement: The joy clues are in. Now for the small admin habits that reveal everything.

questions.prompt: Which tiny joy works every time?
choices: Fresh air and a good little errand
Laughing until the plan changes
A quiet corner and something comforting
questions.explanation: Joy habits show what kind of fuel actually reaches you.

questions.prompt: You find a class for something random. You...
choices: Consider whether it fits real life
Sign up because the story needs texture
Save it and never open it again
questions.explanation: Curiosity is strongest when it becomes something you can actually touch.

questions.prompt: Pick a hobby mood.
choices: Steady, satisfying, and quietly impressive
Chaotic, hilarious, and possibly expensive
Soft, familiar, and low-pressure
questions.explanation: Hobby mood reveals how you like your free time to feel.

questions.prompt: Which compliment would secretly delight you?
choices: You seem really grounded
You make things more fun
You know how to take care of yourself
questions.explanation: The compliment you want often names the energy you value.

questions.prompt: Your “I am alive” moment is usually...
choices: Sunlight, movement, and a clear head
A ridiculous story unfolding in real time
Realizing I can say no and stay home
questions.explanation: Alive moments point toward the kind of life you are drawn to protect.

questions.prompt: If your life had a theme song today, it would be...
choices: Calm beat, steady bassline
Fast chorus, dramatic bridge
Lo-fi comfort on repeat
questions.explanation: Your imaginary soundtrack is basically your energy report.

stageGroups.title: Life Admin
stageGroups.encouragement: Life admin never lies. Your final vibe is nearly ready.

questions.prompt: Your unread emails are...
choices: Mostly handled before they become folklore
A pile of good intentions
A thrilling problem for another day
questions.explanation: Inbox style is modern personality archaeology.

questions.prompt: A bill, form, or appointment reminder appears. You...
choices: Deal with it while it is still small
Put it somewhere safe, then forget where safe is
Set three reminders and still feel suspicious
questions.explanation: Admin habits reveal whether you reduce pressure or multiply it accidentally.

questions.prompt: Your home when life gets busy is...
choices: A little messy, but recoverable
Evidence that a side quest happened
A comfort cave with snacks nearby
questions.explanation: Your busy-home style shows what your energy prioritizes.

questions.prompt: Which personal rule would help you most?
choices: Do the two-minute task now
Leave room for surprise
Rest before everything turns dramatic
questions.explanation: The rule that helps most often points to your missing ingredient.

questions.prompt: Your future self would thank you for...
choices: Making one boring thing easier
Collecting one unforgettable memory
Taking a proper break before crashing
questions.explanation: Future-you choices reveal the lifestyle pattern behind the jokes.

questions.prompt: Which phrase makes you feel called out?
choices: I know exactly what I should do, annoyingly
This could either be brilliant or a mess
I need to stop treating rest like a reward
questions.explanation: The phrase that stings a little often carries the clearest signal.

questions.prompt: Choose the life pace that feels most like home.
choices: Steady enough to last
Fast enough to sparkle
Soft enough to recover
questions.explanation: Your preferred pace helps confirm the final lifestyle-style result.

questions.prompt: Which version of older-you sounds most believable?
choices: Wise, active, and weirdly good at routines
Still saying yes to questionable plans
Comfortable, cozy, and surrounded by favorite things
questions.explanation: Older-you is imaginary here, but the fantasy still reveals your vibe.

questions.prompt: What would give your life more years-left energy?
choices: More small habits that do not feel like homework
More fun that does not require recovery paperwork
More rest before the warning lights blink
questions.explanation: This answer names the adjustment your personality keeps circling.

questions.prompt: Pick the final motto.
choices: Keep it simple. Keep it joyful. Keep going.
Make the story worth retelling.
Protect the peace like it pays rent.
questions.explanation: A motto works because it compresses your whole vibe into one tiny flag.

questions.prompt: Which result would secretly make you grin?
choices: Centenarian energy, but with better snacks
A chaos legend with surprising durability
A reset era that actually sticks
questions.explanation: The result you hope for can reveal the lifestyle identity you already like.

questions.prompt: Final check: what are you choosing more of?
choices: Balance, movement, laughter, and sunlight
Stories, surprises, and yes-energy
Calm, comfort, and a real pause
questions.explanation: Your final choice gives the quiz one last clear personality signal.
